name: Vipula Dissanayake
bio:
Vipula is a PhD candidate at the Augmented Human Lab, University of Auckland. He has completed his masters of engineering degree in bioengineering from the University of Auckland in 2019 and his bachelor’s degree in computer science and engineering from the University of Moratuwa in 2016. After graduation, he has worked in a software company for one year of design and implementing intelligent software solutions for a travel domain. With an interest in exploring technologies, he had decided to join the Augmented Human Lab.

Apart from his interest in technology, he enjoys traveling and photography, and badminton.
